correctness.rationale: Exact stationary Markov generator recurrence through total degree six reconstructs the normalized cumulants. Derivative numerators have exactly one positive zero by Descartes sign variation at each q≥0; the endpoint limits and sign directions prove global maxima. Increasing q raises each logarithmic derivative, while a q-independent positive ratio derivative on the entire interval containing the fourth optimum forces the sixth optimum to its right. The symbolic checker reproduced generator moments and all polynomial identities, and verified finite exact-rational witnesses; the analytic arguments, not root samples, prove the universal conclusions.

value.rationale: A natural two-bath experiment seeks the reset rate giving strongest fourth- versus sixth-order departure from Gaussianity. These distinct observables respond to different tails; the exact result shows unique, strictly ordered optima for every noise temperature and a bounded, monotone thermal shift. The temperature-invariant ratio and its strict derivative supply a structural explanation and an inference-relevant prediction beyond mere evaluation of moment formulas. The theorem is not an arbitrary parameter slice or small numeric improvement.
